parsed_json.up: Select chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mesh_heading, first_approval from molecule_dictionary. Inner join drug_indication on molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Left join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 for approved drugs. Return DISTINCT rows over the requested output columns. Sort by first_approval descending, then by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mesh_heading as tiebreakers.
